text:
Hello to front-counter team,
Handover calls, later this week: a short note from our desk

We are seeing the usual mix of bookings, rechecks, and last-minute route adjustments, so please keep each conversation calm and clear. When a traveler comes in with a pet, a steady welcome and a few simple steps go a long way. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is here to support with concise guidance that helps families feel looked after, while also keeping our files tidy and accurate. If any document looks incomplete, please pause, confirm what is missing, and note the gap in the record so the next person can continue without confusion.

For animal welfare, please remember that each pet should be treated with patient attention by trained staff at every stage of the handover. If there is a concern about stress, carry, spacing, or general readiness, bring it to the desk right away so we can respond in a practical way. We want every traveler to leave with clear expectations and a sense that Aurelia Skyways is taking care of the whole journey, not just the ticket. Short, kind, and actionable guidance is usually the best support, especially when people are balancing tight plans and worried pets.

If Ines Okafor or Aya Torres appears in the queue, please route the file through the usual review path and keep the conversation reassuring. Sasha may also be mentioned in passing, and that should be handled with the same calm attention as any other companion animal. Thank you for staying patient, accurate, and welcoming at the front counter. It makes a real difference to the families we serve.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
